The Angels of Starbound
Why they are here, with us.

Forever protecting and wandering, the Angels' ^orange;sole purpose^reset; is to ^green;protect Mortal beings^reset;, although they ^red;do not^reset; understand them well at all.

Angels, with their "weird names" and strange way of talking, can ^orange;barely^reset; get along with the races they are supposed to ^green;protect from harm^reset;.

Created from ^green;the beginning^reset;, by the great and mighty ^yellow;Cultivator^reset;, the Angels knew what to do from the very start.

However, when the Cultivator oh so gracefully ^orange;sacrificed Itself^reset; for the races of our universe, ^red;the Angels became unstable^reset;. They did not know what to do without a creator, who was like their gentle commander, guiding them. ^orange;They began to slowly break down^reset;.

Oh woe, and ^orange;so they broke down^reset;.. Many Angels started wandering in space, looking for a new "commander" to work under. Some Angels became corrupted by the Ruin, and some Angels ^green;settled down^reset; on planets to live a ^green;peaceful life^reset;.

Being an Angel was no longer about simply "protecting all the races", now, as a Angel, you could almost..live..^red;like a Mortal^reset;?

There are, however, still patches or groups of Angels who strictly remember the ^green;Code of the Cultivator^reset; and follow it ^orange;sternly^reset;. They do their best to patrol our universe, protecting our races from harm and the Ruin.
Test Results
Results of adding ^green;Angel blood^reset; to ^red;mortals^reset;.
Code of the Cultivator
A holy book of rules Angels must follow. It seems...^red;outdated^reset;.
The Many Different Kinds of Angels
An outsider's view of the different kinds of Angels.

^green;I have been graciously allowed to venture into many Angel Villages and speak with the locals^reset;.
Thanks to this type of cooperation, I've been able to ^yellow;record and analyze^reset; the many different ^orange;"types" of Angels^reset;.

I will explain each type in this book.
Moving On
Why we have left our Sacred village behind.

At first, when an Angel outsider came into our village, all of us were ^orange;upset and frightened^reset;. That Angel should have known, through the Code, ^red;that they were not welcome here^reset;. That is what..we thought, at least.

As time went by, they began to tell us stories from the outside world..and how our Code was..somehow..^red;wrong^reset;? Most of us did not believe this random Angel at first.. ^yellow;But their tales kept drawing us closer and closer^reset;.

Eventually, most of us were convinced to leave our village and pursue the ^green;true meaning of the Code^reset;, to finally fulfill our destinies.

I cannot believe it, but tomorrow is the day when we all will set out into the world.. And it is all thanks to that mysterious Angel, too.

^yellow;I wonder how they are doing^reset;..
Taking Over
Mission complete.

The Ruin will be pleased to know we found this Apex testing facility and took it rather..^red;forcefully^reset;..from its original owners.

With all this..^orange;ugh, disgusting technology^reset;...maybe we can find a way to ^orange;combine Angel blood with filthy mortals^reset;, finding a way to restore the Ruin's power even more!

^red;There is only one way to find out^reset;!!
Have We Been Found?
Possible Angel spies around us...

Someone needs to remember to go to the main Leader and tell them that we saw a wandering Angel outside of this facility.. I think it may be one of those "regular" Angel heathens.

We CANNOT be found out! ^red;IN THE NAME OF THE RUIN!!^reset;
The Ruin-Killer
The history of the Ruin-Killer.

We found out about the ^yellow;Ruin-Killer^reset; first when Archangel Xequeyzriel told us about a ^green;particular person^reset; helping ^orange;Esther in the Outpost^reset;. The Angel we sent there to blend in saw someone running past---into the Ark.

Archangel Xequeyzriel asked our spy to stay in the Outpost and watch for anything else.

Archangel Xequeyzriel always had a feeling someone was ^green;destined to save the universe^reset; ever since the Cultivator sacrificed Itself. We did not know who or what it was going to be..

But, the Ruin-Killer is ^yellow;everything we imagined them to be^reset;! Strong, resilient, steadfast... They were perfect!

^green;We watched as the Ruin-Killer developed over time^reset;. We asked Archangel Xequeyzriel why he did not want them to enter this Realm. If they were so trustworthy, what was he waiting for?

..^yellow;He would not answer us^reset;.

^green;Finally, when the Ruin itself was conquered^reset;, Archangel Xequeyzriel was going to allow the Ruin-Killer into the Realm, until we heard news of the ^red;Ruined taking over an important Apex testing facility^reset;.

Archangel Xequeyzriel had the perfect idea of testing the Ruin-Killer's faith and goodness once again.
The Realm of the Angels
Archangel Xequeyzriel's personal realm.

^orange;Archangel Xequeyzriel^reset; keeps this Realm together, the Realm we call "^green;The Realm of the Angels^reset;".

Archangel Xequeyzriel stays in his temple, ^green;controlling and maintaining his Holy Power^reset;, to allow this place to continue to exist. It looks like he does it so effortlessly!

Everyone here knows he made this Realm to form a plan against the Ruin. ^orange;We do not blame him for not knowing he would have to remain here forever^reset;.

^green;How could he have known^reset;? He had never made his own Realm before. He had always been right next to the Cultivator.

^green;All of us are thankful for creating this Realm for us^reset;---this safe, secure home away from the Ruined and the Ruin itself.

Though, we pray for our fellow brothers and sisters outside of this Realm.

^yellow;May they find peace^reset;...
A Realm of My Own
How I created The Realm of the Angels.

I, ^green;Archangel Xequeyzriel^reset;, the ^orange;Ultarubim^reset;, created this Realm thousands of years ago.

The news had just spread amongst my fellow Angels---the Cultivator fought the Ruin and sacrificed Itself---splitting into near infinite, wild pieces. There was panic, anger, regret..

^green;But I knew what I had to do during all that chaos^reset;.

^green;I had a feeling this would all work out^reset;. That although the Cultivator was split apart---destroyed---scattered..everything was going to be okay. It is almost as if..the Cultivator was fine with the future ahead.

It created me, the first of the ^yellow;Original Angels^reset;. Its power flows through me like a running river. Sometime before It battled the Ruin, It told me how I could use my power to keep others safe.

^green;Was it all on purpose^reset;?

^green;I learned how to create my own Realm, from the Maker Itself^reset;.. It was such an honor. If only I knew the burden I would have to bear..

But, no. ^orange;I never regret it^reset;. I have known these Angels for thousands of years, and this is a special place. Maybe, someday, the Angels outside will understand.


^yellow;Maybe, one day, they will join us, and we can truly unite against the Ruined^reset;.
The Colors of Angel Wings
How the color of an Angel's wings plays a role in their Power.

Angels outside of this Realm probably do not remember this, but the ^yellow;color^reset; of Angel wings matter.

^green;The color defines our Holy Power, just as the shape itself does as well^reset;. Whether you are an Angel or not, knowing what you are up against is crucial to survival. ^orange;Especially against the Ruined^reset;.

Read further to see ^cyan;the Power levels of every Angel type^reset;.
Holy Power
How Do Angels Work?

The Angels' ^green;Holy Powers^reset; are from the ^yellow;Cultivator^reset; Itself. The Cultivator, who used to be a beacon of life and light, ^green;shared Its power with the Angels^reset;, making them become like It. With the Cultivator's powers, the Angels could do good works for the universe.

Angels assisted the Cultivator by protecting Its ^green;many planets, full of life and diversity^reset;.

Not only do Angels have this Power, but it is said that ^red;Demons^reset;, ^orange;terrible creatures of the night^reset;, ^red;also have a similar Power^reset;. Their Power is made from something else..^red;something horrid and scary from the Ruin Itself^reset;.

The Ruin corrupted so many innocent creatures and Angels alike, making them become ^red;minions of destruction^reset;.

Humans and other Mortals ^red;can't^reset; have supernatural powers like Angels and Demons.

They do, however, have ^green;the advantage of technology^reset;. Angels were never the type to ^orange;truly appreciate technology^reset;..unless it's a space ship.

Angels may have their powers, but ^green;Mortals^reset; have their ^green;creative minds and limitless potential^reset;.
The Rebels
The Angelic Rebellion.

We are the ^green;Angel Rebels^reset;, a part of the ^green;Angelic Rebellion^reset;.

No, we are not fighting against our own kind..at least, ^green;not physically^reset;. We ^red;FIGHT^reset; the notion that technology ^red;MUST^reset; be rejected. We ^red;FIGHT^reset; the "norms" that are taught to new Angels.

^green;Why^reset; shun technology when it can ^green;help^reset; us? We can use it to fight the ^orange;Ruined^reset;! We can use it to take the fight further!
We must continue to fight, no matter what! Technology brings us ^green;closer and

closer^reset; to stopping the ^orange;growing numbers^reset; of the Ruined.

^orange;No matter^reset; what our fellow Angels think of us.. We will ^green;stand and unite^reset; with the Mortals to fight the Ruined!!

^yellow;Huzzah^reset;!
Angelic Fusion
An Angel explains how more Angels are created in this day and age.

^green;Angels do ^red;not^green; reproduce in the more conventional ways, similar to Mortals^reset;.

All Angels have a form of divine energy coursing through their bodies, ^orange;but^reset; the Holy Power an Angel is born with will be ^yellow;only one^reset; of ^green;two energy wavelengths^reset;.

The ^#00BFBF;Alpha energy wavelength^reset;, or the ^#FF3F92;Omega energy wavelength^reset;; with Angels having a ^green;fifty-fifty chance of getting one or the other^reset;.

In order for a ^green;new Angel to be created^reset;, ^yellow;two^reset; Angels with ^orange;opposite energy wavelengths^reset; must combine their power in a ^yellow;specialized ritual^reset; that acts as the catalyst for Angelic reproduction.
This is only possible in ^green;calm, safe environments^reset; and ^orange;never a war-zone^reset;.

Once they know they are safe, the ^#00BFBF;Alpha wavelength Angel^reset; and an ^#FF3F92;Omega wavelength Angel^reset; will stand apart, facing one another. They both ^green;channel their respective energies^reset;, with the pure energy of the ^#00BFBF;Alpha Angel's

energy and the ^#FF3F92;Omega Angel's^reset; energy glowing as two separate colors. Angelic ^yellow;runes^reset; can be seen ^green;floating around in the energy^reset;, with the rune type in the ^#00BFBF;Alpha energy wavelength^reset; looking different from the rune floating around in the ^#FF3F92;Omega energy wavelength^reset;.

The ^#00BFBF;Alpha^reset; and ^#FF3F92;Omega^reset; wavelength energies will ^yellow;combine^reset;, swirling together in a ^green;beautiful glowing display^reset;, which causes an orb of combined energy to grow larger and get brighter during the process. When

finished, there will be a blinding flash, and a ^yellow;new Angel^reset; will be seen laying on the ground where the ^#00BFBF;Alpha^reset; and ^#FF3F92;Omega^reset; wavelength energies were ^green;once being combined^reset;. This new Angel will have ^cyan;Cupid wings^reset; and be ^orange;very weak^reset;, visually appearing to be an adult but mentally not the same.

The parent ^#00BFBF;Alpha^reset; wavelength Angel and parent ^#FF3F92;Omega^reset; wavelength Angel will then teach this ^green;new Angel^reset; everything it needs to know about the universe and its purpose, along with all the traditions and customs of Angel

culture.

In the ^green;olden times^reset; when Angels were at the ^green;height of their power^reset; in the glory days with the ^yellow;Cultivator^reset;, new Angels would ^yellow;instantly be born with all of the knowledge^reset; they need about life, the universe, Angelic law, and how to use their Powers.

With the Cultivator gone, new Angels must be ^green;taught^reset; how to ^orange;speak, fight, use their Powers, and the Code^reset; that all Angels are bound to follow. ^green;Some^reset; Angels mature quicker than others,

but ^orange;most^reset; Angels are considered mature enough to no longer need the teachings or guidance of their parents at ^green;27 years old^reset;. This is still an ^orange;extremely young age for an Angel^reset;, since ^yellow;most can live to 10,000 years^reset;. Even still, at 27 years old, an Angel most likely knows enough to ^green;continue their learning and journey in life independently^reset;.
The Death of Angels
What happens to an Angel after they die?

An ^green;Angel^reset;, whether dying on the battlefield or being whittled away by the Ruin, ^red;WILL die eventually^reset;.

I will describe to you, the reader, what happens when we, Angels, die; and our ^green;traditions after death^reset;.
away^reset;, becoming nothing as well. What is left is an empty husk of a once known powerful being.

^cyan;Burial Traditions^reset;
The body left behind acts much like a Mortal's; for it can begin to ^orange;deform and decompose^reset;. Before this can happen, friends or family of the fellow Angel will ^green;bury the deceased into the soft ground^reset;, at the ^yellow;local cemetery^reset;. For as we, the Angels, were made to ^green;protect everything the Cultivator has made^reset;, we can still use our bodies after death to ^yellow;provide new life and nourishment^reset;. The late Angel's body will provide nutrients for the many flora that grow in our cemeteries.

^green;This is how we respect the dead^reset;.
This same tradition applies to the ^red;Ruined^reset;, for even they were ^orange;once like us^reset;.
They deserve a proper, respectful burial themselves.

Once the Angel has been buried, their ^green;place of eternal rest^reset; is ^yellow;marked^reset; with a ^green;proper headstone^reset;.

Friends or family of the late Angel may come to ^green;visit once in a while^reset;, leaving flowers as a gift.
^yellow;A tradition we adopted from Mortals^reset;.
Preventable Measures
A self-help book on how to prevent becoming one of the Ruined.

As Angels, we have to worry about the ^orange;loss of our ^yellow;Holy Power^reset;, along with the threat of ^orange;possibly becoming like the ^red;Ruined^reset;.

In this handy self-help book, we, many Angels, have come together and agreed on the best ways of ^green;preventing yourself from becoming one of the Ruined^reset;.
if the ^yellow;Cultivator^reset; is on your side, you won't become a Ruined at all.

We hope that this book may come in handy for the many Angels scattered around this vast universe. ^green;Please, share this info with any fellow Angel you know^reset;.

Thank you for reading.
Celestial Essence
A self-help flyer on "Celestial Essence".

^orange;Please make copies of this flyer and give them to any young Angels you know.^reset; Thank you!

^yellow;Celestial ^violet;Essence^reset; is a magical substance that can be left behind by ^green;Angels or Demons^reset;.
Despite our differences, it powers us. ^green;When we die, we lose a piece of it - leaving it behind^reset;.

This left-over essence can be used for the benefit of yourself or others...however, it can also be used for evil.
Wings of Angels
What are they made of?

The wings of Angels are magnificent to see. The feathers are soft and plush ^gray;(depending on the wing type)^reset;, shining in the sun - ^green;gleaming with Holy Power^reset;..

^yellow;But what are they really made of^reset;?

They are in fact made of the righteous Power that Angels wield. The Power they got from the ^green;Cultivator^reset; powers everything - from their wings to what they ^green;craft^reset;.
The Ruined
An observation of Ruined Angels.

^red;The Ruin, an enemy to all living things, has returned^reset;! And with its return, it has brought even more destruction and sorrow. First, the Ruin obliterated the Earth--and ^red;NOW^reset; it knows how to corrupt our fellow Angels! ^orange;What will we do^reset;..?

The way the Ruined talk is ^red;crazed and loud^reset;, speaking only of the Ruin and death. Sometimes, you may even find fanatic Ruined Angels wearing clothing of the Ruin. ^red;Dark colors, full of shadows^reset;..truly opposite of us, who are full of light!
A holy book of rules Angels must follow, written in a old language.
An Ancient Race
A young Angel describes the history of Angels.

Although I am only ^green;319 years old^reset;, I know of many things that many of my peers do not know about our ^green;own^reset; race.
Apparently, back when the Cultivator still existed, ^yellow;we spoke an ancient language^reset;. The name of the language has been forgotten, and yet still many Angels speak it. My peers do not know of this language, but I do. I want to study it and learn how to speak it!

I also heard that Novakids may know this language! Though, every time I tried to talk to one using bits and
pieces of the ancient language, they would only stare at me in confusion. ^green;How weird^reset;!

I've learned much more than that, as well.
Because the Cultivator is gone, our Holy Power is ^green;slowly but surely running out^reset;. We used to live forever alongside the Cultivator ^gray;(apparently, I wasn't there)^reset; but now we only are expected to live a ^green;mere 10,000 years^reset;! That's very low. I do not know what happens to us when we truly die.
I hope that we join the Cultivator once again in death, ^green;wherever It may be^reset;.

Over these past hundred years, I've noticed the decline of our race and what the Ruin has done recently. I fear ^green;we may not be able to keep our promise to the Cultivator^reset;.. I surely hope It comes back.. somehow. Our broken brethren, the Ruined Angels, cannot come back to the light--forever taken and shattered by the power of the Ruin. If we, the Angels, cannot protect the Mortal races anymore, then... ^red;Who will^reset;?
-^yellow;A Young Angel^reset;
Loss of Holiness
Describes how typical Angels and the Ruined lose their Angelic powers.

^orange;Ruined Angels, who have been taken over by the Ruin itself^reset;, slowly begin to lose themselves to its curse.
They become ^red;erratic, strange, and hungry for destruction^reset;. When an Angel becomes Ruined like this, there is ^red;no way^reset; to bring them back--for the Ruin is already absorbing their Holy Power from them. Yes, you saw that right. The Ruin is ^red;leeching^reset; off of controlled Angels.. The Ruin slowly steals Holy Power from Ruined Angels. This, of course, is to make the Ruin more powerful.

^green;Angels typically lose Holy Power over time because there is no Cultivator to sustain them^reset;.
Age will cause Angels' Holy Power to decrease and wither. When nearing a very low point in Holy Power, Angels will be unable to craft holy items. Their hands will only be able to make Mortal items from then on. Then, as it progresses, their wings become wilted, and their Halo is taken from them as well. With the ^green;only remnant of a former Angel being their glowing eyes^reset;. When this time has come, ^red;death is soon^reset;.
^green;They shall join the Cultivator soon..peacefully^reset;.

^green;The Ruined lose their Holy Power because of the Ruin itself.^reset;
The Ruin drains the Holy Power from Angels it has taken over. As an Angel begins to ^red;rapidly^reset; lose Holy Power in this way, something ^red;major^reset; happens. Their Halo will turn sickly and dark, with their ^orange;Holy Power leaving their body in bits and pieces^reset;. They will not be able to craft Angelic items anymore. Their minds will shatter and break - ^red;leaving only madness and suffering behind^reset;.

Those who are Ruined..^red;their wings will turn colors^reset;, turning blackened and weak. Eventually, they can even lose their wings. The ^red;same fate^reset; for ^green;their Halo^reset;, as well. It crumbles and fades from them - ^orange;leaving them a husk of their former self^reset;. They are hell-bent on destroying Angels and Mortals alike. ^red;All in the name of the Ruin^reset;.

The only thing left losing their wings and Halo is..^red;eventual death^reset;. The Ruin would have absorbed all their Holy Power, and the Ruined become weak and perish.
A painful and disgusting way to die, but at least in the end ^green;the Ruined may unite within the arms of the Cultivator above^reset;.
The Most Ancient Angel
The one Angel who saw the sacrifice of The Cultivator.

^green;There have been rumors around lately about a powerful Angel who saw the very battle between The Cultivator and the Ruin^reset;! This ancient Angel is supposedly still alive and not corrupted!

If this is true, then that means there is hope after all.. If this Angel truly does still exist, then it may be the ^yellow;great Archangel Xequeyzriel^reset;.. Archangel Xequeyzriel is said to be one of the ^green;first Angels ever created by The Cultivator Itself^reset;! Archangel Xequeyzriel is supposed to be the

literal embodiment of light, hope, and holiness--all fused together to create ^yellow;a powerful being second to The Cultivator^reset;....but that in of itself is ^orange;only a rumor^reset;, as well. No Angel has any written knowledge other than rumors of Archangel Xequeyzriel.

Oh, Cultivator, hear my prayer.. ^green;Please, let the rumors be true^reset;.. Truly let Archangel Xequeyzriel guide us! Wherever he may be..
Mortal Sacrifice Theory
How to make the Ruin more powerful?

For the Ruin, ^red;every sacrifice counts^reset;.
Even our own kind. The Ruin absorbs mortals and us Angels alike..or...It ^orange;ALLOWS^reset; us to be a part of Its ^orange;GLORIOUS^reset; army.
As a part of Its army, ^red;we must destroy the other Angel heathens^reset;, and bring more mortals to the Ruin.

^orange;However, our army has come up with an interesting idea^reset;..

What if there was a way to combine ^green;Angel blood^reset; and ^yellow;mortal blood^reset;?
^orange;No^reset;, the mortal ^orange;wouldn't become Angelic^reset;. That's pathetic. But..what if..the mortal became ^red;a being of great power^reset;..? And..if that blood-powered mortal was ^red;sacrificed^reset; to the Ruin..would Its power grow even more than normal?

^orange;That is what WE must find out^reset;..

This mural describes an ancient temple filled with treasures, belonging to the feathered-ones.
This mural depicts "Kluex" giving gifts to his followers. Do those feathered-ones really believe in something like this?
The writing on this Avian statue describes the history of their "god", Kluex.
Some sort of disgusting, foul webbing.
Looks like one of those Mortal games. I think this one is called "chess".
An aquarium with a miniature island on top. There are no fish in this tank, however.
This machine can turn pixels into almost any shape. I do not understand how it works, but it is quite useful.
This machine can be used to craft pet related items. Taming wild creatures sounds..interesting.
I can make tools to indentify fossils with this thing. This way, I can learn more about the past..
This iron table is used for crafting various equipment.
This type of advanced station can be used to make "mech" parts.
I can use this to craft items relating to rails.
This machine takes ores and turns them into pixels.
This adds additional ranged equipment to the replicator.
This adds additional high-tech equipment to the replicator.
This adds additional melee equipment to the replicator.
This nature station is used for producing items that relate to hunting, mining, and farming. Nature is your best tool!
The furnace.. A classic invention of Mortals. It is quite useful for smelting ores.
This station, called the "apothecary", is good for making materials that treat wounds. A crucial component in the Mortal world.
Another classic invention of Mortals---the spinning wheel. I can spin yarn and make clothing, fabrics, and other ingredients here.
I can use this table to expand my knowledge.
Equipment used for wiring can be made here. It is quite complicated, but I will get used to it..
An airlock hatch, styled after the cultists and the Ruin. FOUL!
Some sort of creepy altar. Begone, Demons! ..If there are any...
This is an electric fluffalo egg. Mature electric fluffalos are a great source of static cells.
This is a fire fluffalo egg. Mature fire fluffalos are a great source of scorched cores.
This is a common fluffalo egg. Mature fluffalos are a great source of plant fibre.
This is an ice fluffalo egg. Mature ice fluffalos are a great source of cryonic extract.
This is a posionous fluffalo egg. Mature posion fluffalos are a great source of venom samples.
This trap attracts moths that produce silk fibre. It can then be weaved into silk cloth, a luxurious Mortal material.
Thorny, prickly fruits grow on this prickly plant.
This mushroom appears to be of Agaran origin, the shroomy-ones.
Bamboo woven into a door. This door is strong.
Barbaric Floran tales are carved onto this tall bone.
I think this entire table was carved from a single, humongous bone. How could any Mortal eat here...?
This bookcase was made from the remains of creatures killed by the leafy-ones.
This cabinet is made from stretched leather between large tusks. Strange, but impressive.
An unrefined crate made from wood and bone.
This desk is most likely used by a "greenfinger" of a Floran tribe.
This rickety door looks highly unstable. Does it even keep the weather out?
What type of creature resides in this thing? I better stay back...
This eerie pod emits a green light. I am not entirely sure if it is..natural.
Floran instructions on how to build a fire.
An unlabelled tally chart. I wonder what the tallies stand for?
This furry-one appears to still be alive.. Did they crawl in by choice...??
This screen has pouches filled with animal remains in the back. I think this is a place for  food preparation.
This table was crafted out of a small tree.
This table is binded together with rope. This was most likely made by a Floran.
This animal pelt is being stretched between two large bones. Is this some sort of decoration?
An empty plaque. Will a weapon or trophy get displayed here in the future?
Bamboo woven into a door. This door is strong, but certainly does not keep the outside weathers out.
Parts of a skeleton are arranged on this spike. Is this a warning..or decoration?
This skull appears to be Human....
Penguin bones arranged on a pike. Poor bird!
An arrow has been carved into this rock. Is this a trick, or a guide? Hmmm..
Railing made of bones.. This seems quite sturdy.
This railing is quite sharp since it is pikes tied together.
The head of a creature, mounted on this plaque. Its eyes seem to follow me...
These crossed wood planks make up this crude plaque. The skull hangs on.
Plants woven into a bedroll. It is infested with tiny insects... Blegh!
This organic Floran bed looks like it belongs in a prison.. Is that what this is?
Why does this bedroll have a wooden frame with wheels...?
An organic plant light. Pretty!
This small cabinet is made from organic materials and wood. This does not have a lot of storage.
This large cabinet is made from organic materials and wood. This is crudely crafted.
I cannot tell the purpose of this plant. It is formed like a dispenser..but for what?
Some type of organic glowing orb.. It appears I am able to store a few things inside it..!
These logs are arranged to be able to support a heavy weight, and are a great platform.
This log structure appears to be temporary.
The leafy-ones must use this to torture their prisoners.. Hmph, such brutality does not surprise me..
This special plant seems to resist the heat of the torch, and does not catch on fire!
What a strange looking fountain...
I am going to need special Mortal tools to clean and prepare this fossil. I wonder what this used to be?
An undecorated altar. There is not a single carving.
This machine has the game "Super Tralgar Blaster 2" on it. I have never heard of it or played it before.
An iron barred door, for keeping prisoners in.
This symbol must mean something important.. Is there something dangerous nearby? I must prepare myself..
Burning coals could easily burn any Mortal's flesh. I should stay safe too, however.
This bush has attracted many small butterflies.
An opened box. Simple.
An electric hanging light made from copper.
I can put produce or meals into the create and fire it into space. I will get pixels for the items delivered.
This mechanical station seems to be processing a lot of data. I cannot really understand what is entirely going on here.
An electrical barrier. It looks dangerous, but I feel rather..safe.
Fireflies are attracted to particular bush. I wonder why?

Angel Flag

Angel flag makess good point to teleport back to ussing teleporter

I can bookmark this Angel flag for quick teleportin'.

Extremely bright lights. I should not stare at them for too long.
This frog is not saying anything, but it looks like a merchant?
This wondrous machine can observe and make small things appear larger!
This has taken heavy damage and appears to be broken.
This console is entirely made out of iron swords.. The swords at the top function as levers..
Voices can be heard through this sound machine to try and communicate.
Here I can craft and customise my personal mech machine.
This light beacon guides where I should land my mech.
My pet chicken would love this small house, I bet!
Some type of Mortal vehicle, but it does not seem to work.
The data on this screen is displaying information on this planet.
I am not sure what this machine is doing. It appears to be measuring something, though.
I feel like this chair could collapse on me at any moment..
I am not sure how to use this or what it is.
This is one heavy duty chest! There must be weapons of some sort stored in here.
These hollow bamboo are strung together and make excellent, soothing sounds in the wind.
An armchair covered in luxurious cushions! I could also sink into this seat..
Quite a fluffy couch! Almost like sinking into clouds...
An unrefined wooden gate. Simple.
Such an adorable little wooden lamp!
Water comes out of this sturdy statue, called a "sink". What an easy way to get water!
This wooden support looks pretty worn out.
It is a "toilet", but made from wood.. Hmmmm, that does not seem right...
This is either a snake or a worm statue. Huh.
Another great invention of the Mortals, the "anvil". Those who excel in metalwork can craft great weapons here.
Blank signs do not help me. No need! I WILL find my destination!
I have been told these tools are for tending to a fire. Why use a tool, when you can use your hand? Heh! ..Though, I think only think fellow Angels can do that..
I think I recognize these tools..perhaps. They are repairing something, but I am not exactly sure what.
Mortals have told me this is some sort of execution device. I can see that, with the visibly sharp blade up top...
I think this may be some sort of machine.. The sand never runs out!
Tools or "utensils" that are used in the kitchen.
Quite a large door! It looks pretty well-built, too.
An armor set placed on a stand. Truly remarkable craftsmanship here! ..Wait, that shield looks moveable..
An axe display. These axes look quite formidable.
Hmm, one of the books on this bookcase looks suspiciously adjustable..
This would be one scratchy bed to sleep in.. I will pass on this.
An extremely flat and uncomfortable wooden seat.
An old wooden chest, reinforced with iron.
An old wooden counter. It has a rich scent about it..
An important looking desk. Looks like a scholar may work here.
An iron lamp powered by oil. It gives little warmth.
An old map that does not appear to be accurate at all.
An old clay plate, gathering dust.
An empty wooden shelf. It seems pretty old.
This looks like something you would use to restrain someone.. But, why does it smell like rotten fruit...?
This tile seems to be loose... Time to find out if it really moves!
One of these chains looks..odd. I better check it out!
The smell is horrid! Why am I inspecting this?!
This is a rather ominous wooden sign.. But as an Angel, I can face any dangers ahead!
I sense this barrel contains something toxic. I better not look inside.
This familiar shape.. This must be a "trash can"! Garbage bags are stored in here.
This looks like a "treasure chest" because of its form. I should look inside!
Some sort of spinning toy.
Giant golden bells! The sound they make is music to my ears..
This looks like one jolly Mortal! ..Fills me with a bit of happiness, heh.
Is this a giant snowflake? Ugh..
I can use this strange forge to make Mortal "holiday" decorations..!
I can use this strange table to make Mortal "holiday" decorations..!
This plant is called the "holly"! Apparently, this plant is used with one of the Mortal holidays.
Is this a snowflake? Ugh..
Fairy lights spell out "Waz". What does "Waz" mean?
Spiky wire, coiling around itself. This looks excruciatingly painful.
This must be a "TV"! However, I think this machine has not worked in a while.
The amount of data on this mechanical screen is overwhelming.. I cannot read it all.
This cabinet has the recognized colors for danger - yellow and black. A strange smell comes from it..
Some sort of commanding machine, perhaps? The levers are rather tempting to pull, but I shall leave them be.
This computer has a ton of buttons.. Is this really neccessary?
From the writing on the screen, this seems to be a "personal" computer. I am not the prying type, so I will leave this be.
Huh? Some of the writing on here talks about Angels and how to find them.. But why?
Data that I cannot comprehend.
Is this a projected moon or planet?
This machine is demanding to scan my eyes.. Well, hmph, if you insist! Look into my bright, glorious eyes!
This device scans hands, it seems. But, for what purpose?
This machine is radiating with soothing heat. Hmm..
I think this machine is scanning for movement. Should I stay still or actually move?
There is a lot of tiny writing on this panel that I cannot possibly understand.
Seems like a scan of a person. Are they doing alright?
This seems like a recruitment machine. Recruiting for some military, I believe..
I am always calm, but thanks. Even without the last word I am one with peace.
I am not upset, furry-one.
This cabinet is filled little lights. It constantly makes soft beeping sounds.
Silky, luxurious curtains.
The music coming from this box is quite jubilant.. I almost want to dance!
The "USCM"? What does that stand for, I wonder?
This machine is used to heat up food. I heard it can be rather dangerous, though..
An "oven", used almost like a furnace - to cook or bake meals.
This barrel is full of oil, steadily burning in the flames. This is a crude heat source.
This rusty cabinet looks like it used to contain various items. Those are all gone now, of course, because it was broken into.
These screens are displaying feed from security cameras. Time to make sure everyone is behaving...
An "exit sign"! This way to leave, I assume.
Taking a look into this cabinet, I can see a file about a person who tried to rip the wings off an Angel.. Despicable scum! No wonder they belong here.
Taking a look into this cabinet, I can see many files about evil Humans. Just how many are there?
Some sort of containment device for prisoners, I assume? A cell of some sort? There is a force field around it..
I will get out when I want to, not when some writing is telling me that I should.
You cannot tell an Angel what to do! I will face whatever danger is ahead!
Wait, is this written with..Mortal blood?! Disgusting... And no, I will not.
The writing on this screen details on how to interact with prisoners. Hmph! I know perfectly well how to handle them...
This paper has been ripped to shreds and the writing is smudged. Too bad.
This little paper talks about a prisoner "study group" for learning about other cultures and acquiring new skills. ..If they were once a bad person, could they realy change, just like that...?
Metal pipes have been fashioned into a fence-like form. Heh, smart.
This stone display almost looks like a gravestone. It has "USCM" written on it.
I belive this Mortal creation is a "vending machine". If I put in Mortal money, food or drinks come out. Clever!
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Psychedelic Rodeo Melee".
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Stylish Thief Wasteland".
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Sleazy Burger Heroes".
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Screaming Fashion Agent".
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Cool Wizard Island".
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Starbound".
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Zombie Banana Mansion".
I am confused.
This stool seems rather uneven.
I think this toy or "plush" is supposed to look like a bear, one of the many Mortal creatures.
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Beautiful Attempt!"
This light is red, and then green.. What is it trying to tell?
This is either a picture or a painting of a cityscape. I will admit, the view is decent.
An ornate chair, fit for those of importance.
This object is used to make a noise if you hit the center "gong".
The lily pad decorative rotates so that the doors of the ornate wardrobe may open.
The fishy-one's symbol of their people - with the crystals representing their three eyes.
Baby frogs are swimming inside this floor ornament. Does this represent the fishy-ones in some way?
An ornate hand-crafted paper lantern. I better watch this, since it could easily catch on fire..
I think this strange machine detects when there is liquid present.
I think this teal box is a "mailbox", for sending letters.
This painting of a mountain has glorious colors and emotion put into it..
I think this sign may be saying to either buy or collect seashells..
I think this sign may be saying to either buy or collect lily pads..I think?
I cannot read this sign, other than the fact that there is an Apex on it.. Is that supposed to be that important furry-one, "Big Ape"?
There are little fish swimming inside this neon blue sign.. So, is it directing towards an aquarium?
I believe this neon green sign is directing towards a restaurant. Trying the fishy-one's cuisine would certainly be interesting!
Is this sign asking for the Hylotl to steal children from the surface...? No, that cannot be right..
I want to pull this lever, but I am not sure if I should really do that..
An adorable little fountain. The sound of the water is relaxing..
What in the Maker is this used for?
I have heard of this from some Mortals.. This sign is for the Letheia Corporation. I have been told this wealthy company is run by Hylotl..
This poster tries to be frightening or scary, but I am not swayed.
An adorable little plush. However, I will pass on taking this.
This sign clearly tells me if the pump is on or off. I can work with this!
I have been told that the feather and ink can be used to create calligraphy.
Is this shop really having a sale? I will find out soon enough.
I think this sign indicates that I must stand here and wait. Though, why should I?
This lamp makes a pleasant 'click' sound when I turn it on.
This plaque describes "Study in Female Hylotlgy", and references dates and names. Something related to art, perhaps?
This is an "antenna", used to pick up signals. I wonder who may be listening in..
This ancient door can only be entered from one direction. I cannot come back once I have gone through this door.
An extremely old painting of some animals.
Crude depictions of the Florans while hunting.
This tentacle creature looks like the Ruin. Hmph, foul being...
I do not understand how it works, but if I die, I will simply return here.
This dirt does not seem right.. The way it feels under my weight is odd...
This statue depicts a grand Floran hunter.
If I ring this, it will make a loud sound and alarm everyone. ..That is the whole point of its existence.
Oh, really?
We shall see about that!
I do not think so.
By the Maker, what a discouraging sight..
This metal machine can project images that are not physical.
Sleek beds that can stack on top of each other. This looks similar to the beds at the Protectorate academy..
This machine is a laser cannon, I think. I wonder if I can activate it..
This chest looks rather special! I wonder what may be inside?
What ever is so hazardous around here?
This sign states clearly whether it is off or on. Convenient!
I think this machine senses when I get too close. I better watch my step.
This ancient symbol means the number "one".
This ancient symbol means the number "two".
This ancient symbol means the number "three".
The light of this switch indicates the status.
Jagged metal. It is quite sharp.
I feel like I will not be able to stand on this platform for long, so I better be ready to jump and fly!
This looks like a "treasure chest" because of its form. I should look inside! ..Wait...
This machine projects a magenta palm tree. My hand can go through it..
The shopkeeper does not appear to be a metal-skin, but is indeed mechanical.. Hmmm..
I am unable to tell if the sheets are made from real animal hide.
The chair has a noticable, strange smell, but at least the cushions are nice and soft.
The metal symbol on this old wooden door is not familiar to me.
Decorative horns are hung on a display. They are made of brass and are clearly fake. I bet this would really anger a Demon...
The metalwork on this lamp is beautiful!
An iron lamp post. An imposing light keeps the Demons away...
I believe this is an old water pump. It does not work.
If I cross this swining door, I better prepare myself for anything that could happen!
An electric light source. The warmth is nice, but a real fire would be better.
An uncomfortable-looking chair, but the cushion makes up for it.
There is a disgusting mess inside this pot..
An old wooden wheel. It is simply decoration.
This looks like a really old version of the "computer", that I have told about. It is quite interesting that it still works.
An old desk made from wood and metal, garnished with a couple of drawers.
There is a mess of wires everywhere.. And all these compontents jammed together is not pleasing.
I know of this! A "stapler"! This is also a weapon, right?
This shop sells teleporters, a rather convenient way of fast travel.
This stall appears to be closed. I will have to check on it again some other time.
If I mark this teleporter, I can return to here with a different teleporter at any time.
This is a "fire extinguisher", useful for putting out fires that have gotten out of hand.
This frog merchant is selling various furniture sets from around the universe.. Fascinating!
This large metal box is being turned into a store, it seems.
I believe this booster belongs to a mech, but it is hanging, suspended by chains.
This metal sign has a mech symbol on it. A mech station must be nearby.
The number zero.
The number one.
The number two.
The number three.
The number four.
The number five.
The number six.
The number seven.
The number eight.
The number nine.
An airlock door with a rail attached. I do not think any weapon could damage this.
This metal table has various tools needed for proper cooking and food preparation.
This machine generates power.
An airlock hatch, made from strong materials. I do not think any weapon could damage this.
An airlock hatch with a rail attached. I do not think any weapon could damage this.
This bright screen does not really show anything but blue lines.
This looks like a powerful "computer". Unless it is not, since I am not well-edcuated in this field of technology..
The padding on this chair is rather comfortable. I could lean back and relax..if only for a moment.
This bright screen is showing something but it is hard to make out what it is exactly..
This counter was made from cheap wood. It looks pretty roughed up.
This blinking sign catches my eye easily. The "Beak Easy", huh?
Are these technically criminals? Hmm...
What a rather giant anchor.. Was it smashed into the top of this crate? Is that why it is closed?
This vendor sells excellent weapons! I am quite interested.
This mechanical merchant can fix or repair broken vehicles. Why, thank you!
This captain sells vehicles. Perhaps I will take a look..
This Penguin is busy with this object.
This machine can print and scan signs.
I can craft personalized signs here. I can spread the good word!
This stall is certainly curious - I wonder of its purpose..
This machine only sells tech consoles. Maybe I should get one..
This machine is currently offline, so I cannot find out its purpose quite yet.
This shop is selling farm supplies, as well as terraforming tools.
I think someone is in the process of turning this metal box into a store. They already have installed a tree of some sort, I see.
This mysterious trader wants rare items in return for his wares. Interesting; I will oblige.
This heavy chair could withstand fierce attacks. It could also make for an effective barricade!
This computer looks severly outdated...I think.
An automatic door with the symbol of the Peacekeeper Initiative.
This frog merchant is selling Peacekeeper furniture.
It seems someone is very close to solving a big case. Yes, get that criminal!
This Mortal pastry is supposedly very unhealthy but tasty. Should I try it, or not, then...?
This advanced console can keep track of the condition of the space station.
I should hurry and pick up this Matter Manipulator...
This Grand Protector has a rather serious look.
The plaque for this picture reads, "Esther Bright - Former Grand Protector". Curious.
Wait, this is Leda.. She is the one who gave me the Matter Manipulator before.........
This machine is clearly broken beyond repair..
Torn fabric is laying on the ground. Maybe I should pick it up.
Uh oh, it would appear I am very late.
An tight airlock door, with a symbol of the Protectorate.
I would not mind resting again, but I should surely go and hurry to the ceremony.
I do not need to use this. I need to head to the ceremony!
This fire extinguisher has never been used, thankfully.
These figures are nice to look at. They are adorable.
Maybe I could pick up this flower, in memory of today. It does look quite nice.
I have sat on this bench often, but never truly read the plaque. It reads, "In honour of Esther Bright".
This old tree is said to be as old as the academy itself. I admire it for this feat alone.
This is a guitar! I do not have time to try it out, though.
If I am confused on something, I can easily ask this kind fishy-one for advice or tips.
This chair has a egg-like appearance to it. Sitting in it makes me feel safe and comfy.
These student lockers are perfect for storing away useful items. These are locked, however.
These student lockers are perfect for storing away useful items. This particular one belongs to me.
Each of these banners represents a race. The ones I am sworn to protect. The Novakid flag is missing, though..
This table is so sleek and clean, I can see my reflection!
There is a news program on the "TV", but I cannot hear what is going on.
This vending machine sells sugary drinks and snacks. These often keep Mortals energized and awake, or so I hear. Is it purely beneficial?
This picture shows the first ever Grand Protector. He looks like he has so much wisdom to share...
This former Grand Protector has a kind look about her. I bet we could have gotten along well..
This former Grand Protector was the first ever non-Human to fill the role.
This former Grand Protector looks old, but the spark in his eyes tell otherwise.
This former Grand Protector seems like she was a calm pacifist. I bet she would not even hurt the tiniest of creatures.
This poster shows a "UFO".
This is the local "radio". This sound box is good for hearing news around the universe or here on Earth.
This machine scans bags for anything malicious. Doing a good deed.
This ship is my way out of this crumbling mess!
This smoke is getting in my way.. Where is it coming from?
I have been told the Protectorate launches these into the cosmos so they can land on a nearby world. The pod chests are helpful for Protectorate explorers.
Empty shelves, where either capsules, pod chests, or status pods can be stored.
This water container is clearly damaged! The water must have leaked through to the room below.
These chimes give off a pleasant sound. I could sit and listen to them forever...almost.
